skill.name: architect-review
skill.description: Reviews major software architecture decisions for scalability, resilience, maintainability, security, and alignment with modern architecture patterns.
skill.summary: Reviews architecture decisions for scalability, resilience, maintainability, and pattern alignment.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static system-reconnaissance matches are false positives. The cited lines contain safe architecture review guidance and cloud strategy topics, with no command execution, host discovery, data access, exfiltration, or prompt-injection intent. No semantic security issues were found in the reviewed SKILL.md content.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid approving high-risk changes without validation plans.
- Multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architecture strategies

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 34 tells the reviewer to require validation plans before approving high-risk architecture changes. This is defensive review guidance, not host or network reconnaissance.
Line 75 lists multi-cloud and hybrid cloud architecture strategies as a review capability. It does not instruct the agent to enumerate systems, scan infrastructure, or collect environment details.

content.value_statement: Architecture reviews often miss long-term scalability, resilience, and maintainability risks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured architecture assessment.
actual_capabilities: Reviews architecture decisions for scalability, resilience, maintainability, and security impact.
Evaluates clean architecture, hexagonal architecture, microservices, DDD, and event-driven designs.
Identifies architectural violations, anti-patterns, and risky coupling between system boundaries.
Recommends tradeoffs, refactoring options, and validation plans for major design changes.
Helps document decisions with architecture decision records and C4-style views.
limitations: Requires meaningful system context, goals, and constraints.
Does not replace performance testing, threat modeling, or production observability.
It is not intended for small code-only reviews with no architectural impact.
Recommendations may need validation against team standards and runtime data.

use_cases.title: Review a Major Design Change
use_cases.description: Assess service boundaries, data ownership, and operational impact before implementation.

use_cases.title: Validate Cloud-Native Architecture
use_cases.description: Evaluate Kubernetes, service mesh, CI/CD, and scaling choices against reliability and cost goals.

use_cases.title: Guide Product-Aligned Architecture
use_cases.description: Translate business goals into architecture tradeoffs, risks, and decision records.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Architecture Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a proposed system design.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this system design for scalability, maintainability, and security. Focus on the main risks, assumptions, and practical next steps: [paste design].

prompt_templates.title: Microservice Boundary Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of service ownership and coupling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate these services and data flows. Identify weak boundaries, ownership conflicts, coupling risks, and changes that improve domain alignment: [paste context].

prompt_templates.title: Event-Driven Tradeoff Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of asynchronous architecture choices.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this event-driven architecture. Review event ownership, consistency, failure handling, observability, and whether event sourcing or CQRS fits the goals: [paste design].

prompt_templates.title: Architecture Governance Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for architecture boards and technical leadership.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposal as an architecture reviewer. Produce impact level, pattern compliance, architectural risks, validation plan, and ADR-ready decisions: [paste proposal].

output_examples.input: Review a plan to split billing from a monolith into separate services.
output_examples.output: The review would assess service boundaries, data ownership, transaction consistency, migration risk, and operational readiness before recommending next steps.

output_examples.input: Assess a migration from REST calls to asynchronous events.
output_examples.output: The review would compare coupling, failure handling, consistency, observability, and rollout checkpoints for the event-driven design.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a Kubernetes platform proposal for a growing product team.
output_examples.output: The review would examine deployment flow, scaling strategy, service mesh need, cost controls, security boundaries, and team ownership.

best_practices: Provide architecture diagrams, service boundaries, data flows, and known constraints.
Ask for tradeoffs and validation plans, not only a final recommendation.
Include nonfunctional requirements such as latency, reliability, compliance, and cost targets.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for minor style or syntax reviews.
Requesting approval without sharing context, risks, or acceptance criteria.
Treating guidance as a substitute for tests, threat modeling, or production metrics.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews architecture patterns, service boundaries, quality attributes, and major design changes.

faq.question: Is it for code review?
faq.answer: It can review code changes when they affect architecture. It is not for routine local edits.

faq.question: Does it run tools or commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is guidance text and does not include scripts, network calls, or command execution.

faq.question: Can it create ADRs?
faq.answer: It can help draft decisions, tradeoffs, assumptions, and follow-up validation steps.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code according to the report metadata.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide goals, constraints, diagrams, service lists, data flows, and expected growth.
